title: i made a soon page
content:
visit my soon page

 

I made a soon page - a space to hold some creative seeds I’m planting and which, hopefully, will germinate in the soil of my psyche, also made public to you here.

I figured that if my journal is called “recently” (that is, recent past) and my archives holds 600+ posts from the more distant past, then it should only make sense that I have a near future page.

here’s some seeds that I planted on Friday.

  • labyrinth library — an inner, gated labyrinth within my public labyrinth (this website), inspired by this post I wrote last year, build a labyrinth, not a funnel. I’m imagining this to be part creative/business library, part community offering.

  • workshop constellations — I have a gazillion ideas for workshops I want to teach and a lot of inertia and competing projects, so I thought I’d make a space to put syllabi and course descriptions here, like a cosmic, evolving course handbook they give you at the beginning of school semesters.

  • questions for myself — this is a hybrid audio/video series project that I’m super excited about, inspired by my advising sessions and recent course, creative systems.. I’ve realized that all the insights and revelations I’ve ever had emerged from me asking questions to myself, and talking through them outloud, or writing them. my advising sessions and teaching work are all externalizations of this process. so, I’d like to share it.


I’m about to hop on a plane and go to China for two weeks, so I don’t know when I’ll be able to water any of these seeds, but hopefully they’ll be budding in this next season.

visit my soon page
author: Kening Zhu
